intended_use: Tactical allocation decision support. The engine may change the size or timing of discretionary additions; it is not an automatic brokerage execution system.
known_limitation: The current rules were developed with historical 2021-2026 data visible. Anchored replay is leakage-controlled but cannot retroactively make rule selection truly out of sample; the immutable ledger is the clean forward test.
freeze_policy: Any change to decision thresholds, analog matching, regime definitions, sizing rules, timing scores, confirmation rules, or validation methodology requires a new strategy_version. Historical results for prior versions must remain preserved.
notes: The dashboard decision engine remains the single source of truth.
backtest.py, walk-forward validation, and the signal ledger call the same engine.
Walk-forward calibration uses only observations available before each test period.
The live signal ledger never overwrites a prior prediction; changed predictions become new immutable revisions.
Version 2.1 gates validation training rows by outcome-known date and aligns exposure changes to the executable next-session open.
